items.source: Configures the MongoTypeMapper to be used to add type information to Documents created by the converter and how to lookup type information from Documents when reading them.
items.translation: 配置MongoTypeMapper，以便在转换器创建的Document中添加类型信息，并在读取这些Document时从中查找类型信息。

items.source: Default implementation of MongoTypeMapper allowing configuration of the key to lookup and store type information in Document.
items.translation: MongoTypeMapper 的默认实现，允许配置用于在 Document 中查找和存储类型信息的关键字。

items.source: Returns the TypeMapper being used to write type information into Documents created with that converter.
items.translation: 返回用于将类型信息写入由该转换器创建的Document的TypeMapper。

items.source: Spring Data MongoDB specific converter infrastructure.
items.translation: Spring Data MongoDB 专用的转换器基础设施。

items.source: Uses of MongoTypeMapper in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.convert
items.translation: MongoTypeMapper 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.convert 中的用途
